name: Milena Petrović
bio:
Milena's journey into motorsport started unexpectedly. While pursuing a degree in supply chain management, a chance encounter at a local karting event ignited a passion she never knew she possessed. She quickly realized the logistical complexities behind a successful race team fascinated her more than traditional corporate environments. After graduating, she interned with a small touring car team, learning the ropes from the ground up.

Milena joined Sprint V8 Team three years ago, and has proven to be an invaluable asset. She thrives in the fast-paced environment, meticulously planning and coordinating the movement of equipment and personnel. Her calm and organized approach ensures everything arrives on time and in perfect condition, allowing the team to focus on performance. Milena is known for her ability to anticipate potential problems and proactively implement solutions, making her a vital part of the team's success.

What sets Milena apart is her unwavering attention to detail and her genuine care for the well-being of the team. She understands that logistics isn't just about moving things; it's about supporting the people who make the magic happen on the track.

physical.hairStyle: Long, wavy, often pulled back in a practical ponytail or bun.
physical.description: Milena is of average height with a practical build, always looking ready to handle any logistical challenge.

quirks: Color-codes all packing crates and transport manifests with an elaborate system.
Insists on having a precisely organized toolbox at every race, even though she rarely uses it.
Always carries a small, well-worn notebook filled with logistical checklists and contingency plans.
